stories.title: Bathroom wall threat prompts extra patrols at Houston ISD elementary school
stories.summary: HISD says Highland Heights Elementary will have additional police patrols Friday. Classes will proceed as scheduled.

stories.title: Conroe ISD elementary teacher arrested on child pornography charges
stories.summary: A Conroe ISD elementary teacher faces three felony charges. Investigators say they're examining whether additional offenses occurred.

stories.title: Police investigate reported threat at Humble High School, constable says
stories.summary: Police are investigating a threat reported by an anonymous caller at Humble High School. Multiple agencies responded Friday morning.

stories.title: 'Give him the honor that he's due': Navy sailor Kenneth Lynch finally to be buried in Texas, 85 years after Pearl Harbor attack
stories.summary: The sailor, who left Denton in 1940, will be buried with full military honors next month in his hometown.

stories.title: Corvette driver arrested twice in 9 days after Houston police chases
stories.summary: A Houston Corvette driver is accused of reaching 120 mph during a police chase, leading to his second arrest in nine days.

stories.title: Houston neighbors complained about illegal dumping near Buffalo Speedway for months. Now, action is expected
stories.summary: Southwest Houston residents say illegal dumping has blocked sidewalks near Buffalo Speedway for months. City crews are scheduled to address the problem.

stories.title: Harris County sees troubling shift in traffic crashes, sheriff's office says
stories.summary: Pedestrian crashes are declining in Harris County, but rising bicycle and e-bike crashes have officials urging caution as holiday traffic increases.

stories.title: Police investigating Houston crash that left 8-year-old critically injured
stories.summary: An 8-year-old boy is in critical condition after an east Houston crash. Emergency responders performed CPR as police investigate what caused the collision.

stories.title: Cornyn blocks Trump's pick for Texas judge as GOP tensions grow
stories.summary: Sen. John Cornyn is blocking Trump's nominee for a Texas federal judgeship, citing a lack of vetting as Ted Cruz warns time is running out for confirmation.

stories.title: Buyers are paying top dollar for items belonging to inmates who may not even know they're being sold
stories.summary: Letters and artwork from high-profile inmates are sold online, raising concerns about the impact on victims’ families and calls for tighter rules.

stories.title: Lexus theft raises questions about how thief bypassed SUV’s security
stories.summary: A Lexus was stolen from a Houston driveway in seconds. Investigators are working to learn how the thief bypassed the vehicle's security system.

stories.title: Houston SuperFeast organizers make urgent plea for Thanksgiving food donations
stories.summary: Organizers expect to serve more than 30,000 people at the annual Thanksgiving event and say demand for assistance is growing.
